summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Package @onereach/messengers-infobip-sdk@0.1.3 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, checks whether `bun` is on PATH and if not downloads the Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` inside the package. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line JavaScript file heavily obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (rotated numeric/string array `n7gIxM` with rotation function `WV8StW`, hex-mangled identifiers, custom decoder `hc1jfK9`), so its actual behavior, network destinations, and data reads are hidden behind string-array and custom-base64 encoding. The package is advertised as an Infobip SMS/MMS SDK and has no documented need for a second language runtime to execute a hidden sibling script at install time. The combination of an alternate-runtime dropper (Bun fetched only to run this file), a large obfuscated payload auto-executed by the lifecycle hook, and a purpose mismatch with the declared SDK role means installing this package hands install-time code execution on the developer or build host to whatever `math_init.js` decodes to.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
